title: When the Protocol Sings
author: Lena Thornbury
blurb: Casper Crane, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
